Description: Stale parking availability. If garage updates are delayed, occupied spaces may appear available. Failed reservations and loss of driver trust.
Response strategy: Mitigate: Validate timestamps and availability before confirming reservations. If it occurs: Hide stale spaces and notify affected drivers.

Description: Conflicting reservations. If simultaneous requests are not handled atomically, two drivers may book the same space. Double bookings and refunds.
Response strategy: Mitigate: Use database transactions, unique constraints, and concurrency tests. If it occurs: Cancel the duplicate booking, offer another space, and refund if needed.

Description: Third-party service failure. If mapping or payment APIs fail or change, navigation or checkout may stop working. Drivers cannot navigate or complete paid reservations.
Owner: Payment Integration Team / Mapping & Location Services Team
Response strategy: Mitigate: Test API contracts, monitor errors, and implement timeouts and retries. If it occurs: Show parking addresses and temporarily pause paid checkout.

Description: Unauthorized access to user data. If authentication or permissions are weak, attackers may access personal or reservation data. Privacy harm, remediation work, and delayed release.
Response strategy: Mitigate: Apply least privilege, encrypt data, review permissions, and test authorization. If it occurs: Disable affected access, contain the incident, and follow the incident response plan.

Description: Scope growth. If new requirements are added without reprioritization, planned work may exceed semester capacity. Missed milestones and incomplete deliverables.
Response strategy: Mitigate: Baseline the SRS and assess each proposed change against remaining time. If it occurs: Defer lower-priority features with approval and retain required deliverables.

Description: Late external access. If API credentials or garage data access arrive late, integration work may be blocked. Dependent tasks and testing start late.
Response strategy: Mitigate: Request access early and track external dependencies in Trello. If it occurs: Use clearly labeled mock data or sandbox APIs for planning and testing.

Description: Cross-team integration delay. If teams deliver incompatible interfaces, web, mobile, and backend integration may require rework. Testing and final delivery are delayed.
Response strategy: Mitigate: Agree on interface contracts and schedule early integration checkpoints. If it occurs: Prioritize a working end-to-end flow and reassign integration tasks.

Description: Insufficient testing time. If earlier work consumes the testing buffer, critical defects may remain near submission. Unreliable demonstrations or incomplete validation.
Response strategy: Mitigate: Reserve testing time and test each milestone as it is completed. If it occurs: Fix critical defects first and reduce optional demonstration scope.

Description: Underestimated service costs. If API usage or cloud traffic exceeds assumptions, operating cost estimates may be too low. An inaccurate budget and inefficient resource use.
Response strategy: Mitigate: Estimate usage by scenario and review provider pricing and quotas. If it occurs: Revise cost estimates and optimize excessive usage.

Description: Incorrect charges or payouts. If rates, fees, or billing rules are implemented incorrectly, drivers or operators may receive wrong amounts. Refunds, reconciliation work, and financial disputes.
Response strategy: Mitigate: Define billing rules and test totals, receipts, and operator reconciliation. If it occurs: Pause affected billing and correct charges and payouts.

Description: Refund and chargeback losses. If cancellation rules are unclear or payment fraud occurs, disputes may increase. Revenue losses and administrative costs.
Response strategy: Mitigate: Publish cancellation rules, retain transaction records, and use provider fraud controls. If it occurs: Review disputes, issue valid refunds, and adjust controls.

Description: Revenue leakage from outages. If checkout or reservation services are unavailable, otherwise bookable spaces may generate no platform revenue. Lost transactions and lower operator returns.
Response strategy: Mitigate: Monitor paid booking flows and plan service recovery. If it occurs: Restore checkout first and reconcile interrupted transactions.

Description: Team member unavailability. If a key contributor is absent, tasks dependent on that person may stall. Delayed work and workload imbalance.
Response strategy: Mitigate: Document work, assign backup owners, and review capacity weekly. If it occurs: Reassign tasks and adjust the sequence of work.

Description: Skill gaps. If contributors lack experience with payments, security, or mapping, work may need repeated correction. Defects and slower completion.
Response strategy: Mitigate: Assess skill needs early and use training, pairing, and reviews. If it occurs: Assign specialist support and simplify optional complexity.

Description: Poor team communication. If decisions and interface changes are not shared, teams may work from different assumptions. Duplicate effort and avoidable rework.
Response strategy: Mitigate: Record decisions in GitHub and keep Trello tasks current at weekly check-ins. If it occurs: Hold a coordination review and reconcile conflicting decisions.

Description: Limited stakeholder participation. If drivers or parking operators do not review requirements, the design may miss real workflows. Low usability and late requirement changes.
Response strategy: Mitigate: Schedule stakeholder reviews and record feedback and acceptance criteria. If it occurs: Use representative scenarios and flag unvalidated assumptions for review.
